channel.title: Monki Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Monki on macOS.

item.description:
# Monki 1.0.3
- Added secure in-app updates, with manual checks and configurable background checks and downloads. - Added English, Russian, Spanish, German, and French interfaces, following macOS language preferences. - Improved brightness and volume recovery when a monitor responds incompletely during startup or after wake. - Preserved normal macOS key behavior when a monitor does not support a requested DDC control.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later.
Install this first Sparkle-enabled release manually. Future releases can be installed through Monki's updater.
